content.text: That sounds brutal, and two hours of screaming would flatten anyone. Long middle-of-the-night screaming at this age is common, and tonight's one thing to try is a steady, boring response. Go in, keep the lights off and your voice low, and stay close with a hand on him. Skip the big rescue, the snacks, and the talking. If he seems asleep or foggy while he screams, that can be a night terror. Waking him usually makes it last longer. If he's truly awake and upset, a quiet cuddle is fine. If the screaming comes with fever, pain, or anything that worries you, call 811 any time, or 911 if it's an emergency.
